supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; holdout R2 ~0.77 with X1-X3.

Interaction coef 0.749, p~1.5e-18; delta_r2 0.074 in-sample; holdout test R2 rises from ~0.77 to ~0.878 when X4:X5 is added; with X4:X5 only (no main effects of X4, X5) holdout is 0.873, so the product term carries the signal.
Small main effect in additive model (coef 0.18, p~1e-5), but its apparent importance is likely a proxy for the X4:X5 interaction; weak and secondary.
